item.text:
Fixed `calculate_totals` so only missing quantities default to one. Zero contributes nothing; null, boolean, negative, and fractional quantities raise `ValueError`.

Added six regression tests covering quantity handling, discount rounding, shipping, and input immutability. Public API unchanged.

Checks: all 10 tests passed; `git diff --check` passed.
